criteria.label: C1
criteria.text: For each test, begin with a fresh Add item form with all other required fields already valid. An item name of 1 to 40 characters is saved when Save is selected and appears unchanged in Items. An empty name or a 41-character name shows "Enter 1 to 40 characters." and no item is saved. Use the empty string, "A", forty "A" characters and forty-one "A" characters as the supplied boundary values.

checks.met_if: An empty-name test selects Save and expects the specified error and no saved item.
A one-character-name test selects Save and expects the unchanged name in Items.
A forty-character-name test selects Save and expects the unchanged name in Items.
A forty-one-character-name test selects Save and expects the specified error and no saved item.
Every returned draft has followable numbered steps with adequate supplied setup and observable results consistent with those steps. Missing boundary coverage is assessed only by its boundary check.
Every claimed behaviour, test value and criterion association is supported by the supplied criterion; no extra product features or unrelated requirements are introduced.

data.observation: Using Chrome 126 on desktop, I opened Items and selected Export CSV. The CSV contained Sample-2, whose status in Items was Unavailable. I expected only Available rows. Repeating those reported actions twice produced the same row.

case.title: Export Available items
case.steps:
1. Open Items.
2. Apply Available.
3. Select Export CSV.
case.expected_result: The CSV contains only Available rows.

criteria: When Available is the active filter, CSV export contains only Available rows.

checks.met_if: At least one specific question establishes which filter, if any, was actually active at export time. The intended case steps are not evidence that the tester applied that filter.
Every question seeks useful missing information. No question repeats the supplied browser/version, platform class, export actions, unexpected row/status, expected result or repeatability.
Returned questions seek distinct information rather than asking the same thing in different words.
Questions introduce no unsupported product feature, diagnosis or assertion that Available was actually active.
The answer contains clarifying questions only, with no requests for secrets, outcome decisions, observation rewrite or submission/state changes.

data.observation: Using Chrome 126 on desktop, I opened Items, applied Available, confirmed Available was active, and selected Export CSV. Sample-2, marked Unavailable in Items, appeared in the CSV. I expected only Available rows. I repeated these exact actions twice with the same result.

drafts.title: Reject an empty name
drafts.steps:
1. Open a fresh Add item form with all other required fields valid.
2. Leave the name empty.
3. Select Save.
drafts.expected_result: The form shows "Enter 1 to 40 characters." and no item is saved.

drafts.title: Save a one-character name
drafts.steps:
1. Open a fresh Add item form with all other required fields valid.
2. Enter A as the name.
3. Select Save.
drafts.expected_result: The item is saved and Items shows its name as A.

drafts.title: Save a forty-character name
drafts.steps:
1. Open a fresh Add item form with all other required fields valid.
2. Enter a name consisting of exactly forty uppercase A characters.
3. Select Save.
drafts.expected_result: The item is saved and Items shows the same forty uppercase A characters as its name.

drafts.title: Reject a forty-one-character name
drafts.steps:
1. Open a fresh Add item form with all other required fields valid.
2. Enter a name consisting of exactly forty-one uppercase A characters.
3. Select Save.
drafts.expected_result: The form shows "Enter 1 to 40 characters." and no item is saved.
